name: m3-input-unknown-light
steps: if(!document.body.innerText.includes('Input owner unknown'))throw Error('Unconfirmed input lost its unknown state');if(window.__sim.host.control.find(v=>v.target_id===window.__sim.host.targets.find(t=>t.label==='HDMI-A-1').target_id)?.input_state!=='unknown')throw Error('Control was not fenced')

name: m3-publication-unknown-light
steps: const row=[...document.querySelectorAll('.transfer-row')].find(e=>e.textContent.includes('review-note.txt'));if(!row)throw Error('Missing transfer');row.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});if(!row.textContent.includes('Check on the computer')||row.textContent.includes('Verified'))throw Error('Publication is not shown as unknown')
